I can't give you an amount for creatine, whether you're cutting or not. Doses are a call for your doctor or a registered dietitian, who can account for your situation.

For general context, creatine is one of the most-studied supplements in strength training. It's usually taken daily rather than timed around workouts, and it doesn't act as a fat burner, so cutting doesn't change how it works. Water retention on the scale can happen with it, which is worth knowing so it doesn't spook you mid-cut.

If you want, I can set up your cut targets in the app or look at how your lifts are holding up while you diet.
